caption: The drawing depicts a single, ornate sauce boat positioned slightly to the left on a blank background. The sauce boat is rendered in grayscale, with shading to indicate its metallic surface and three-dimensional form. It has a rounded body with three decorative legs; each leg has a fluted design, and the central leg also features a leaf motif at the attachment point. The rim of the sauce boat is scalloped, and the spout extends upward and outward at the front. At the back, there is an elaborate, curled handle, also shaded to indicate its reflective metallic texture. The handle's top curves inward, forming a small loop. The base of the legs is textured, and the entire object is highly detailed, with visible highlights and shadows suggesting a polished metal object. The artist's signature, "M. Fenyo," and the date "29/37" are located in the lower left corner of the page. The background is plain and unadorned, with slight discoloration around the edges.
title: Silver Sauce Boat
